title: A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea
synopsis: “A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea” was written by the great Cantopop lyricist and songwriter James Wong Jim as the theme song for Tsui Hark’s film adaptation of the Jin Yong novel "The Smiling, Proud Wanderer".

fullText.simplified:
流行音乐背后的故事——《沧海一声笑》

    “江山笑，烟雨遥，涛浪淘尽红尘俗世知多少……”歌声响起，中国人骨子里的武侠DNA立刻被唤醒，一位大侠站在山水中的一叶小舟上回望波澜壮阔一生的画面不由自主就浮现在了脑海。这首歌就是潇洒豪放的《沧海一声笑》。
    《沧海一声笑》有粤语和普通话两个版本，但歌词几乎相同，词曲作者都是黄霑。这首歌是1990年上映的武侠电影《笑傲江湖》的主题曲。《笑傲江湖》改编自金庸同名长篇小说，这部小说曾被翻拍成许多版本的电影、电视剧。导演徐克很喜欢小说里男主角潇洒、自由的性格，他找到金庸，表示也想翻拍。金庸很欣赏徐克的品味和才华，欣然同意了。徐克对作品要求很高，即使是音乐也要请最优秀的艺术家来创作，他把这个任务交给了黄霑。
    黄霑是一个很有才华的人，能写歌，会写曲，也能演戏、主持、写书，徐克相信他一定能写出好歌。没想到，黄霑写了三四个版本，徐克都不满意。黄霑有点生气了，他不想修改了，但找资料时看到了古书里的一句话：“大乐必易”，“易”是简易、平易的意思。这句话是说典雅的音乐作品不用追求节奏的繁复，简易的音阶也可以奏出大气美妙的音乐。他受到启发，有了新想法。中国古典音乐是五音阶的，这五个音就是音乐中最小、最简单的元素。他在钢琴上试着把这五个音从高到低反过来弹了一次，没想到弹出来的旋律非常好听。他马上有了灵感，五分钟内，他仅用这五个音就谱好了全曲，半个小时后还配好了歌词。接着他气冲冲地把乐谱发给了徐克，还在乐谱上画了一幅很粗俗的画，并附上一大段粗话。他告诉导演：“你爱要不要！不要就另请高明吧！”没想到徐克拿到乐谱后爱不释手，后来这首歌跟徐克的电影双双成为经典，获奖无数。
    黄霑是一个性格潇洒的人，一生热爱自由敢于直言。在生命最后六年里，他继续追求突破，写下了数万字的博士论文。他在论文里尖锐地指出了香港音乐圈的弊病，吓得最初没人敢评审他的论文。
    《沧海一声笑》里潇洒自由、坦然大气的武侠精神是很多中国人的追求，人们从黄霑那“天地一扁舟，沧海一声笑”的潇洒一生里看到了这种精神。
fullText.traditional:
流行音樂背後的故事——《滄海一聲笑》

    “江山笑，煙雨遙，濤浪淘盡紅塵俗世知多少……”歌聲響起，中國人骨子裡的武俠DNA立刻被喚醒，一位大俠站在山水中的一葉小舟上回望波瀾壯闊一生的畫面不由自主就浮現在了腦海。這首歌就是瀟灑豪放的《滄海一聲笑》。
    《滄海一聲笑》有粵語和普通話兩個版本，但歌詞幾乎相同，詞曲作者都是黃霑。這首歌是1990年上映的武俠電影《咲傲江湖》的主題曲。《笑傲江湖》改編自金庸同名長篇小說，這部小說曾被翻拍成許多版本的電影、電視劇。導演徐克很喜歡小說裡男主角瀟灑、自由的性格，他找到金庸，表示也想翻拍。金庸很欣賞徐克的品味和才華，欣然同意了。徐克對作品要求很高，即使是音樂也要請最優秀的藝術家來創作，他把這個任務交給了黃霑。
    黃霑是一個很有才華的人，能寫歌，會寫曲，也能演戲、主持、寫書，徐克相信他一定能寫出好歌。沒想到，黃霑寫了三四個版本，徐克都不滿意。黃霑有點生氣了，他不想修改了，但找資料時看到了古書裡的一句話：“大樂必易”，“易”是簡易、平易的意思。這句話是說典雅的音樂作品不用追求節奏的繁複，簡易的音階也可以奏出大氣美妙的音樂。他受到啟發，有了新想法。中國古典音樂是五音階的，這五個音就是音樂中最小、最簡單的元素。他在鋼琴上試著把這五個音從高到低反過來彈了一次，沒想到彈出來的旋律非常好聽。他馬上有了靈感，五分鐘內，他僅用這五個音就譜好了全曲，半個小時後還配好了歌詞。接著他氣沖沖地把樂譜發給了徐克，還在樂譜上畫了一幅很粗俗的畫，並附上一大段粗話。他告訴導演：“你愛要不要！不要就另請高明吧！”沒想到徐克拿到樂譜後愛不釋手，後來這首歌跟徐克的電影雙雙成為經典，獲獎無數。
    黃霑是一個性格瀟灑的人，一生熱愛自由敢於直言。在生命最後六年裡，他繼續追求突破，寫下了數萬字的博士論文。他在論文裡尖銳地指出了香港音樂圈的弊病，嚇得最初沒人敢評審他的論文。
    《滄海一聲笑》裡瀟灑自由、坦然大氣的武俠精神是很多中國人的追求，人們從黃霑那“天地一扁舟，滄海一聲笑”的瀟灑一生裡看到了這種精神。

sentences.pinyin: zài shēng mìng zuì hòu liù nián lǐ tā jì xù zhuī qiú tū pò xiě xià le shù wàn zì de bó shì lùn wén
sentences.english: James Wong Jim was a person with a free and easy personality. He was a lifelong lover of freedom and dared to speak his mind.

sentences.simplified: 他在论文里尖锐地指出了香港音乐圈的弊病，
sentences.traditional: 他在論文裡尖銳地指出了香港音樂圈的弊病，
sentences.pinyin: tā zài lùn wén lǐ jiān ruì de zhǐ chū le xiāng gǎng yīn yuè quān de bì bìng
sentences.english: In the last six years of his life, he continued to seek breakthroughs and wrote a doctoral dissertation of tens of thousands of words.

sentences.simplified: 吓得最初没人敢评审他的论文。
sentences.traditional: 嚇得最初沒人敢評審他的論文。
sentences.pinyin: xià de zuì chū méi rén gǎn píng shěn tā de lùn wén
sentences.english: He sharply pointed out malpractices in the Hong Kong music industry in his thesis, ..
.. which initially scared off anyone from daring to review his work.

sentences.simplified: 《沧海一声笑》里潇洒自由、坦然大气的武侠精神是很多中国人的追求，

sentences.simplified: 人们从黄霑那“天地一扁舟，沧海一声笑”的潇洒一生里看到了这种精神。
sentences.traditional: 人們從黃霑那“天地一扁舟，滄海一聲笑”的瀟灑一生裡看到了這種精神。

sentence_translations: The Stories Behind Hit Songs: “A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea”
“The rivers and mountains laugh, the misty rain is far away, how much of the mundane world is washed away by the waves …”
As the song rings out, the wuxia DNA ingrained in Chinese people is immediately awakened.
A great hero standing on a small boat amidst the mountains and rivers, looking back on the epic scenes of his life, naturally comes to mind.
This song is the unrestrained and bold “A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea”.
The song “A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea” has both Cantonese and Mandarin versions, but the lyrics are almost identical.
The lyricist and composer of both versions is James Wong Jim.
This song is the theme song of the wuxia movie “The Swordsman” which was released in 1990.
“The Swordsman” was adapted from a novel of the same name by Jin Yong, which has been remade into many versions of movies and TV dramas.
Director Tsui Hark really liked the carefree and free-spirited character of the male protagonist in the novel.
He approached Jin Yong, expressing his desire to adapt it into a film.
Jin Yong greatly admired Tsui Hark’s taste and talent, and happily agreed.
Tsui Hark has very high standards for his works, and even for the music, he insists on hiring the best artists to create it.
He entrusted this task to James Wong Jim.
James Wong was a very talented person who could write songs, compose music, act, host shows, and write books.
Tsui Hark believed that was more than capable of writing a good song.
Unexpectedly, despite James Wong Jim writing three or four versions, Tsui Hark was not satisfied.
James Wong Jim was a little angry because he didn’t want to make any more changes, ..
.. but when he was doing research, he saw a sentence in an ancient book: “Great music must be plain and simple.”
This sentence means that elegant music doesn’t need to pursue complex rhythms—simple scales can also produce grand and beautiful music.
He was inspired and came up with new ideas.
Chinese classical music is pentatonic. These five notes are the smallest and simplest elements in music.
He tried to play these five notes on the piano from high to low in reverse order.
Unexpectedly, the melody that came out was very pleasant to the ear.
He was immediately inspired, and within five minutes, he composed the entire piece using only these five notes.
Half an hour later, he also finished the lyrics.
Then, in a fit of anger, he sent the sheet music to Tsui Hark.
He even drew a very vulgar picture on it, and attached a long string of swear words.
He told the director, “Take it or leave it! If you don’t want it, then please find someone more capable!”
To his surprise, Tsui Hark couldn’t put down the score after he got it.
Later, this song and Tsui Hark’s movie both became classics, winning countless awards.
James Wong Jim was a person with a free and easy personality. He was a lifelong lover of freedom and dared to speak his mind.
In the last six years of his life, he continued to seek breakthroughs and wrote a doctoral dissertation of tens of thousands of words.
He sharply pointed out malpractices in the Hong Kong music industry in his thesis, ..
.. which initially scared off anyone from daring to review his work.
The free-spirited and magnanimous wuxia spirit in “A Sound of Laughter in the Vast Sea” is the aspiration of many Chinese people.
People see this spirit in James Wong Jim’s carefree life, “A boat floating through the world, a sound of laughter in the vast sea”.
